name: Tony Chou
office: City of San Marino, Member of the City Council

items.text: Tony Chou is a member of the San Marino City Council. He serves as mayor. He was first elected in 2022. He works in wealth management and serves as a Los Angeles County commissioner for local governmental services and a director for LA County Sanitation Districts 15 and 16. Chou supported placing a measure on the November ballot to increase the city’s utility users tax from 5% to 6% to fund police, fire, and library services. His campaign emphasizes public safety, fiscal innovation, and protecting local control. He says the council completed the state-mandated Housing Element, renegotiated municipal contracts for cost savings, and formed a partnership with The Huntington Library that generates recurring revenue without raising resident taxes.
